visualScope: All10 proposed source envelopes inspected in source context; all15 actual new copied rows inspected at216dpi; all23 changed final pages inspected. Existing41 identical pages inherit prior independent review.

independentReview.code: sample_corpus identified missing-page adjacency and final cancellation risks. Both corrected and tested; agent reports ownership/pairing controls address the concrete concerns.
independentReview.output: sample_corpus independently inspected all10 source envelopes, all15 final copied rows, and all23 changed output pages. Confirmed all604 main crops/IDs/order unchanged, all27 prior copies retained, exactly15 new rows, zero whole-row/music intersystem overlaps, no new collision or overflow. Complete printed numerals and all hooks/lines retained. Scope is these two scores, not broad ending recall certification.

limitations: Six of eight Brahms frozen ending envelopes extend beyond the proposed copies (maximum 2.1251802563 pt). Visual source inspection confirms all intended digits, bracket lines and hooks are inside the copies. The omitted envelope margins can contain blank space or incidental nearby music; the full-envelope mismatches remain failures and the frozen oracle is unchanged.

The p6 first ending copy includes a clipped neighboring one-bar-rest count; p32/p36 copies contain adjacent violin-note/slur fragments. These are faithful source rectangles, not clean-isolation results.
Existing whole-neighbor staves and other neighboring ink in main crops remain unchanged.
Other shared directions still need detection; this does not claim complete musical semantics.
Only adjacent1→2 bracket pairs with verified fixed system ownership are supported. Unpaired/third endings, unusual number lists, variable rosters and other source styles remain unvalidated.

The export temporarily stages copied endings as source-only sharedNavigation metadata. App/CLI rerun integration must preserve distinct ending provenance instead of treating these empty-text regions as destination-detector results. No production code was modified for this experiment.
